Package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent

Class TeamAttributes

java.lang.Object
com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.TeamAttributes
public final class TeamAttributes extends Object
Attributes used to create a Select AI Agent team.

The JSON representation follows the CREATE_TEAM attributes accepted by DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT. The database requires the agents attribute and uses a default long-term memory length of 30 when longTermMemoryLength is not specified. Required-field and other database-specific validation is delegated to Oracle Database; the SDK performs only the documented Java range validation.

For a supervisor-led team, supervisorAgent references an agent created with supervisor(true). The agents mappings contain workers only, not the selected supervisor. Use process("sequential") for one-at-a-time worker delegation.

Since:
1.1.0
